definitions: To feel disoriented or confused in an environment that should be well-known or comfortable.
To experience a sense of unfamiliarity or detachment in a place one knows intimately.
examples: After her diagnosis, she started to get lost in familiar places, even her own home.
Sometimes, when I'm really stressed, I feel like I get lost in familiar places, forgetting why I walked into a room.
The old man would often get lost in familiar places, a worrying sign for his family.
lemma: to get lost in familiar places
source: to get lost in familiar places
